title: Scenario-Driven System Validation Harness — MVP (Speed/Feed dimension end-to-end)
depends_on_rationale: SYS-UTIL-AUDIT-MS0 is in_progress and modifies devDispatcher.ts + H:/.claude/settings.json (overlapping files). Sequencing prevents commit-ownership-guard conflicts. ALTERNATIVE: fork to worktree H:/prism-scenario-test-ms0/ on branch work/scenario-test-ms0 if SYS-UTIL takes >7 days, then merge after both land. INTEL-OLLAMA-OBSIDIAN-MS0 + INT-MS0 also touch devDispatcher but are not_started — claim devDispatcher last when this milestone executes (post any merges from those tracks).
rationale: PRISM has 3047 engines and ~6981 dispatcher actions but ZERO end-to-end correctness scorecard against canonical physics. Operator's amateur-authored JM Die programs are NOT optimization targets — they were generated by complete amateurs, so PRISM must BEAT them rather than match them. Without a scenario-driven harness scoring against canonical Kienzle/Taylor/SLD, regressions in speed/feed correctness are invisible until a shop-floor failure. This MVP proves the harness architecture for ONE dimension (speed/feed correctness) end-to-end so MS1 can extend it to the other 8 (cutting params, toolpath typing, repositioning, program efficiency, cost analysis, business management, quoting, CNC output).

in_scope: Schema + storage + generator + scorecard + runner for the SPEED/FEED dimension only
4-layer ground truth: L1 canonical physics, L2 manufacturer envelopes, L3 JM Die feasibility floor (NOT correctness target), L4 hand-crafted adversarial

Hybrid storage: per-run JSON files + JSONL append-only ledger + Qdrant semantic index (NOT DuckDB — zero existing PRISM integration; JSONL matches existing SCRUTINY_LEDGER + ollama-offload-stats patterns)
Comprehensive cadence: pre-commit smoke (~10 scenarios), nightly full sweep (~50 scenarios for MVP), pre-release gate, change-triggered impacted slice
/scenario-test + /scenario-report skills, prism_dev:scenario_run + scenario_report actions, pre-commit Stop hook
out_of_scope_explicitly: Other 8 scoring dimensions (deferred to SCENARIO-TEST-MS1 — explicit follow-on milestone)
DuckDB or any new database dependency (rejected: JSONL ledger meets queryability requirement at zero infra cost)
Full JM Die corpus replay (deferred — MVP uses ~50 synthetic+10 JM Die hybrid; full archive in MS1)
Web UI / dashboard (CLI + JSONL reports only for MVP)

Spindle power: P = Fc × vc / (60 × eta) — power envelope check

units.title: ScenarioSchema (Zod) — input shape for the harness
units.description: Define Zod schema for a Scenario tuple: {id, part: {feature_type, dimensions}, material: {iso_group, name, hardness?}, machine: {id, class, spindle_kw, max_rpm}, controller: {family, dialect}, tool: {id, type, diameter_mm, flutes, coating}, stock: {form, oversize_mm}, volume?: number, customer_constraints?: {tolerance_mm, surface_finish_ra_um, due_date}}. Include ScenarioRun = {scenario_id, run_id, started_at, completed_at, prism_version, output: PrismScenarioOutput, scores: ScorecardEntry[]}. ScorecardEntry MUST carry dimensional units per Mars-Climate-Orbiter rule: each numeric score field is `{value: number, unit: string, source: string}` (e.g. `{value: 552, unit: 'N', source: 'CANONICAL_KIENZLE'}`) — never bare numbers. Bootstrap handling: ScenarioRun has optional `is_baseline_establish: boolean` field — when true, regression detection is skipped (first run for a scenario_id has no prior to compare against; suppresses spurious 'regression' alerts).
knowledge_sources: src/physics/constants.ts AISI_ALIAS for material name normalization
exit_criteria: Schema exports ScenarioSchema, ScenarioRunSchema, ScorecardEntrySchema as named consts
ScorecardEntry numeric score fields are typed `{value: number, unit: string, source: string}` — Zod test rejects bare-number scores (Mars-Climate-Orbiter prevention)
ScenarioRun has optional `is_baseline_establish: boolean` field documented for cold-start regression-suppression
Round-trips 3 reference scenarios from JSON → Zod parse → JSON unchanged
Rejects 3 invalid inputs (missing required field, wrong enum, negative dimension) with specific Zod errors
≥10 vitest tests with toEqual / toMatchObject (no toBeDefined)

abort_criteria: any test fails on reference scenario

units.title: SpeedFeedScorecardEngine — score PRISM output vs L1/L2 ground truth
units.description: Singleton engine: score(scenario, prismOutput) → ScorecardEntry. Computes 5 sub-scores: (1) kienzle_force_error_pct = |prism.Fc - canonical_Fc| / canonical_Fc; passes if <15%. (2) catalog_envelope_compliance = vc/fz inside tool catalog range; binary pass/fail. (3) machine_envelope_compliance = required spindle_kw within machine spec; binary. (4) chatter_safety = ap below SLD critical depth; binary. (5) jm_die_floor_beat = if matching JM Die job exists, prism.cycle_time < jm.cycle_time; nullable. Composite score = weighted average. Writes provenance: which formula used, which constants, which JM Die job referenced.
knowledge_sources: src/physics/constants.ts CANONICAL_KIENZLE (kc1.1, mc per ISO group)
Sandvik/Kennametal published cutting tables for ±15% tolerance justification

Catches per-scenario failures so one bad scenario doesn't abort the suite.
